bodyprogression.name: Body Progression: Assembling the Self
bodyprogression.truth: The body is never given whole. It is assembled, fragment by fragment, each piece a choice.
bodyprogression.qfep_connection: The body in VR begins as absence -- floating hands in void. Each progression step accretes identity onto the avatar: an anchor, a reach, a shape, an outfit. QFEP's lambda parameter governs how much of the self is performed versus given. Drag as performed identity makes the body a canvas, not a container.
bodyprogression.description: From disembodied hands to a full outfit, experience how VR bodies are constructed piece by piece. Each map adds a new layer of embodiment -- hands, anchor point, arms, torso, dress -- revealing the body as an ongoing act of assembly rather than a fixed given.
learning_objectives: Understand VR embodiment as progressive assembly
Learn hand tracking and nail color customization
See inverse kinematics as boundary negotiation
Understand torso estimation from sparse tracking points
Experience outfit selection as performed identity
content: BodyProg_Hands: Floating in Void -- Mirror artifact showing player's floating hands. Learn nail color customization. The body begins as fragments.
BodyProg_Necklace: First Anchor -- A necklace/pendant appears at neck point. First body anchor beyond hands. Identity accretes around a center.
BodyProg_Arms: Reaching Out -- IK arms connect hands to shoulders. TwoBoneIK3D demo. Extending the boundary between self and world.
BodyProg_Torso: Taking Shape -- Torso mesh appears via 3-point estimation. The body as estimated, not given.
BodyProg_Dress: Dressed to Kill -- Full outfit unlocks (ElphabaDress). Drag as performed identity, the body as canvas.
